# How many customers can you lose after a price increase?

> Paste your prices, unit costs and volumes, set a price increase, and see how many units you can lose before the raise stops paying, item by item. Free, runs in your browser, nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.

## Pages

- [The tool](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/price-increase-breakeven-calculator/)
- [How much volume can you lose after a price increase?](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/price-increase-breakeven-calculator/price-increase-guide.html)
